app.title: Timber Trace
app.tagline: Trace timber components with a QR code.

home.title: Schemas
home.heroTitle: Timber components that carry their own data
home.heroText: Timber Trace packs a component's ID, origin, species, dimensions, grade and assessments into a compact QR code. Fixed to the beam, anyone with a phone can read it, even years later and without a database.
home.step1Text: Fill in what you know about the component. Anything you don't know stays explicitly unknown.
home.step2Text: Print the QR code and fix it to the beam. Download a PDF fact sheet or an IFC file for planning.
home.step3Text: Scan the code with a phone camera to open the record. If a newer version exists, you'll see what changed.
home.p1Text: Missing information is recorded as unknown, never silently left out.
home.p2Text: A strength grade always comes with its source and the grading standard.
home.p3Text: The QR code holds the record itself, so it works offline and outlives any server.
home.p4Text: Each schema is a public JSON file with labels in 7 languages, inspectable on its Schema tab.
